patches_added.name: AMOLED dark mode
patches_added.description: Uses a pure black background when Quora's dark theme is on.

patches_added.name: Answer font
patches_added.description: Sets answers in a serif or a sans-serif font of your phone.

patches_added.name: Block Branch tracking
patches_added.description: Turns on Branch's "disable tracking" mode and turns off its debug mode. Branch tracks where installs come from. Quora's quora.app.link links may open with less detail.

patches_added.name: Block advertising ID
patches_added.description: Stops the app from sending your advertising ID and Android ID to Quora.

patches_added.name: Block app telemetry
patches_added.description: Stops the app from sending usage logs to Quora, such as reading time, tab presses, experiments, app speed and errors.

patches_added.name: Block authors and Spaces
patches_added.description: Hides answers and posts by the people and Spaces you pick.

patches_added.name: Block clipboard reading
patches_added.description: Stops Quora's pages from reading what you copied. Pasting with the keyboard still works.

patches_added.name: Block promotional notifications
patches_added.description: Drops digest and promotional push notifications. Replies, comments and other notifications about you still arrive.

patches_added.name: Block tracking logs
patches_added.description: Stops Quora's pages from passing performance and sign-up tracking events to the app.

patches_added.name: Clean shared links
patches_added.description: Removes tracking parameters from Quora links you copy or share.

patches_added.name: Comfortable reading
patches_added.description: More space between the lines and paragraphs of answers.

patches_added.name: Data saver
patches_added.description: Images load only when you tap them.

patches_added.name: Disable WebView debugging
patches_added.description: Stops the app from letting a connected computer inspect its pages, which would show your account's cookies.

patches_added.name: Disable notification prompt
patches_added.description: Stops the app from asking for permission to show notifications. You can still turn notifications on in Android's settings.

patches_added.name: Disable sign-in prompts
patches_added.description: Stops Google's "Save password?" and automatic Google sign-in prompts. You can still sign in with the buttons on the login page.

patches_added.name: Disable swipe gestures
patches_added.description: Turns off pulling down to refresh and swiping sideways between feeds, so a page doesn't reload or change while you read.

patches_added.name: Disable tab prefetching
patches_added.description: Saves data by loading the other tabs only when you open them.

patches_added.name: Disable tracking jobs
patches_added.description: Stops the background jobs that tell Quora every hour whether your phone is charging and every day whether notifications are on.

patches_added.name: Disable vibration
patches_added.description: Stops the app from vibrating when you tap buttons such as upvote.

patches_added.name: Expand answers
patches_added.description: Opens shortened answers in full, so you don't have to tap "(more)".

patches_added.name: Filter keywords
patches_added.description: Hides answers, posts and questions that mention words you pick.

patches_added.name: Hide Ask button
patches_added.description: Hides the button for asking a question in the top bar and on pages.

patches_added.name: Hide Poe
patches_added.description: Hides links and buttons that open Poe or Quora's AI assistant.

patches_added.name: Hide badges
patches_added.description: Hides the red dots and counts on the bottom bar tabs.

patches_added.name: Hide counts
patches_added.description: Hides upvote, view and share counts on answers and posts.

patches_added.name: Hide people suggestions
patches_added.description: Hides "People you may know" and other people to follow in the feed.

patches_added.name: Hide tabs
patches_added.description: Removes the tabs you pick from the bottom bar. Home always stays.

patches_added.name: Keep screen on
patches_added.description: Keeps the screen from turning off while a page is open.

patches_added.name: Patch settings
patches_added.description: Long-press the Home tab to switch the page patches on and off and edit the filters, without patching again.

patches_added.name: Save images
patches_added.description: Long-press an image you opened full screen to save it to Pictures/Quora.

patches_added.name: Spoof installer
patches_added.description: Reports Google Play as the app installer, so Quora does not treat the patched app as installed from an unknown source.

patches_added.name: Start tab
patches_added.description: Opens the app on the tab you pick instead of Home.

patches_added.name: Text size
patches_added.description: Makes the text on every page larger or smaller.

patches_added.name: Spoofer server
patches_added.description: Sends Locket's API traffic (feed, profile, AI frames, captions) to a self-hosted spoofer server instead of api.locketcamera.com. Enter the server address; the app keeps using the server's own HTTPS certificate, so no DNS profile or CA install is needed. Enable the second option to route RevenueCat and Firebase Remote Config through the same server as well. Not selected by default.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a like
patches_modified.description: Switches that make a tap on Like under a post, beside a reel or under a comment, on Follow in a post or beside a reel, or on a reaction at the bottom of a story, ask first, and only Continue goes ahead, so a stray tap doesn't like, follow or react. The story waits while the question is up. All six start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed, Reels and Watch, Stories, and Comments and writing.
